title: Rhythm
description: When Claude works: hour of day, day of week, and the 24-hour pulse.

targets.queryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, count(*) as messages from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1
targets.rawQueryText: select ts/3600*3600 as time, count(*) as messages from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by 1 order by 1

panels.title: By hour of day (UTC)

targets.queryText: select printf('%02d', cast(strftime('%H', ts, 'unixepoch') as integer)) as hour, count(*) as messages from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by hour order by hour
targets.rawQueryText: select printf('%02d', cast(strftime('%H', ts, 'unixepoch') as integer)) as hour, count(*) as messages from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by hour order by hour

panels.description: Counts every assistant message of the Manager and agents.

targets.queryText: select case cast(strftime('%w', ts, 'unixepoch') as integer) when 0 then '7 Sun' when 1 then '1 Mon' when 2 then '2 Tue' when 3 then '3 Wed' when 4 then '4 Thu' when 5 then '5 Fri' else '6 Sat' end as day, count(*) as messages from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by day order by day
targets.rawQueryText: select case cast(strftime('%w', ts, 'unixepoch') as integer) when 0 then '7 Sun' when 1 then '1 Mon' when 2 then '2 Tue' when 3 then '3 Wed' when 4 then '4 Thu' when 5 then '5 Fri' else '6 Sat' end as day, count(*) as messages from messages where ts between $__from/1000 and $__to/1000 group by day order by day
